experiences.name: Kawarau Bridge Bungee Jump
experiences.description: Take the plunge at the world's first commercial bungee jumping site, a 43-meter jump over the stunning Kawarau River gorge. This iconic experience is a must for thrill-seekers and includes a certificate and optional video package.

experiences.name: Routeburn Track Day Hike
experiences.description: Hike one of New Zealand's Great Walks through ancient beech forests, alpine meadows, and past glacial lakes with breathtaking views of the Darran Mountains. The Routeburn Falls section is particularly spectacular and accessible as a day hike.
experiences.location: Routeburn Valley, Mount Aspiring National Park

experiences.name: Franz Josef Glacier Hike
experiences.description: Join a guided hike on the famous Franz Josef Glacier, one of the most accessible glaciers in the world. Walk through stunning ice caves, seracs, and blue ice formations while learning about the glacier's geology and climate change impact.

experiences.name: Milford Sound Kayaking and Hike Combo
experiences.description: Paddle through the majestic Milford Sound fiord surrounded by towering peaks and cascading waterfalls, then hike a section of the Milford Track to Mackinnon Pass for panoramic alpine views. A perfect blend of water adventure and hiking.

experiences.name: Queenstown Food and Wine Tasting Tour
experiences.description: Explore Queenstown's vibrant culinary scene with a guided tasting tour featuring Central Otago Pinot Noir, locally sourced venison, artisan cheeses, and craft beers. Visit local producers and restaurants in the heart of town for an authentic South Island food culture experience.
